decisions: Rejected asymmetric horror game request as infeasible without server/networking support
Built a food intake tracker with nutrient goals and suggestions instead
Used Summit.save/load for persistence across reloads
Preset snack food defined as 620 kcal, 45g fat, 4g protein, 2g carbs to demonstrate an unbalanced/high-calorie low-nutrient food entry
Used Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER instead of literal 9^9^9^9 since that value is unrepresentable and would become Infinity/NaN in calculations
Weight log stored separately via Summit.save('weightLog', ...)
Trend shown as up/down/unchanged compared to last entry rather than a graph
Weight tracking section kept at top of page (was already there)
Suggestion box shows specific foods with nutrient breakdown targeting the lowest nutrient, rather than plain text advice
